notes: Bullion gold and bullion silver deliveries are VAT-exempt under VAT Law No. 3065, Art. 17/4-g, both domestically and on import. Jewellery and coin gold/silver are taxed at the general rate of 20%, but only on the amount remaining after deducting the bullion value (at the Borsa Istanbul closing price) from the sale price (Art. 23/e), so the metal value itself is untaxed.

sources.name: PwC Tax Summaries - Turkey, Corporate: Other taxes
sources.what: The general VAT rate is 20% (rates range from 1% to 20%); gold and silver jewellery are not in the 1% List I or 10% List II reduced-rate categories, so they take the 20% general rate.

sources.name: Vergi Usul Kanunu Genel Tebligi (Sira No: 379) - mevzuat.gov.tr, Ministry of Treasury and Finance legislation portal
sources.what: Official communique stating that under VAT Law Art. 17/4-g, deliveries of bullion gold and bullion silver are exempt from VAT domestically and on import; jewellery and coin gold/silver are subject to VAT at the general rate, with the tax base under Art. 23 being the price after deducting the bullion gold/silver value.
